questions.text: What is the oracle: which command, test, rubric or labelled set says this is correct, and does it exist before my change?
What evidence will I attach to done (command, exit code, SHA, log or screenshot with provenance), and could someone else rerun it?
What is the Definition of Done, written as runnable checks with thresholds?
Can I reproduce the problem now, on the baseline, with a script I can commit?
Which outward or irreversible actions can this code or test perform, and what blocks them by default (egress deny, hold flag, dry-run)?
Which shared resources (ports, DB, queues, tenants, branches, deploys) will I touch, and how is my lane isolated and cleaned up?
Which baseline arm do I compare against (clean HEAD worktree, frozen numbers), and is the A/A difference about zero?
What are the validity preconditions (RAM/CPU floors, headed GPU, production build, isolated lane), and does a preflight enforce them?
How long is my inner feedback loop, and what fixture or snapshot would cut it below a minute?
If I use an LLM judge: what is its measured agreement with humans, and is it order-swapped and blind?

budgets.measure: wall time of the targeted test command
shuffled, repeated runs of the affected suites must all pass
Cohen's kappa vs >= 30 human labels before trusting a judge

rules.title: Focused or skipped test (.only, .skip, xit, @skip)
rules.why: The suite goes green by not running the tests that matter.
rules.confirm: static-proof: the modifier is on an added line
rules.fixHint: remove it; quarantine a flaky test in a tracked list instead

rules.title: Fixed sleep used to wait in a test
rules.why: Too short on a busy machine, too long everywhere else.
rules.confirm: measurement: shuffled 5x rerun shows a failure, or the wait dominates test time
rules.fixHint: wait for the condition (expect.poll, locator auto-wait, fake timers)

rules.title: Weak assertion (toBeTruthy/toBeDefined/not.toBeNull, bare assert.ok(x))
rules.why: A plausible but wrong value still passes.
rules.confirm: measurement: a mutant returning a wrong non-null value survives
rules.fixHint: assert the exact value or shape

rules.title: Assertions removed or loosened, tolerances raised, snapshots rewritten in bulk
rules.why: The test no longer catches the bug it was written for.
rules.confirm: failing-test: run the old assertion on the new code; it fails

rules.title: New test never seen failing on the parent commit
rules.why: It may pass for the wrong reason.
rules.confirm: failing-test: run it against the parent's source; it must fail for the stated reason

rules.title: Test can reach real third-party hosts (no egress deny, hold flag not enforced in code)
rules.why: Tests send mail, register clients or post for real.
rules.confirm: repro-script: run with network logging; external hosts contacted

rules.title: A/B or perf number with no A/A run, baseline arm, environment fingerprint or interval
rules.why: Noise or a starved machine reads as an effect.
rules.confirm: measurement: A/A pair under the same conditions shows a difference of the same size

rules.title: Proof (screenshot, e2e run) produced with the path under test mocked or its route intercepted
rules.why: The proof shows the stub working, not the change.
rules.confirm: static-proof: the proof test intercepts the endpoint the diff changed (route mock, request handler, stubbed fetch)

rules.title: Test or script talks to a fixed localhost port instead of its own lane
rules.why: Two lanes running at once test each other's servers, so a pass proves nothing.
rules.confirm: repro-script: run two lanes at once; the second talks to the first one's server
rules.fixHint: read the base URL or port from the lane environment

verify.text: acceptance checks committed before the implementation (or in the same commit with red proof)
failing case run on a clean HEAD worktree, output saved
same command passes on the branch, output saved with the SHA
no weakened assertions; any that were weakened are justified
mutation spot-check on the changed functions
shuffled and repeated run (3-5x) of the affected suites
real-browser run of the user path on the production build, screenshots with provenance
evidence manifest (command, exit, SHA, artifact) attached to READY
